# Avarra

Avarra is a Software Development company. Avarra is an AI avatar platform that turns your team's expertise into avatars who train teams, support deals, and help customers. Avarra employs 31 people (+55.0% YoY, +11 people). Headquartered in San Mateo, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, and South Korea.

## About

The Avatar Platform to Scale Your People, Plays, and Revenue
Build and deploy AI avatar coaches, product experts, sellers, CSMs and more in less than​ 1 hour.

Coaching & Ramp Execution.
Train and reinforcing your methodologies and best practices while accelerating ramp time and reducing manager oversight. 

Onboarding & Implementation Support.
Avatars guide internal teams and customers through onboarding and implementation, ensuring consistent execution. 

Product, Pricing & Competitive Expertise.
Put product, pricing, and competitive experts on every deal so teams act with confidence and consistency in live situations.

Customer Success & Retention Execution.
Avatars support CSMs through renewals, expansions, and escalations to navigate sensitive moments.

Meeting Preparation & Execution Readiness.
Prepare for critical meetings with the right context, deep research, guidance, and execution focus. 

Execution Visibility & Consistency at Scale.
Track real execution across the revenue org so you can find what works, fix what doesn’t, and scale consistency.
